Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath involved in controversy over Ram temple donation

A controversy has erupted in Uttar Pradesh over a row involving the donation to the Ram temple, with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and opposition leader Akhilesh Yadav at the center. The issue centers on Champat Rai, who allegedly donated land for the temple without permission. Digvijaya Singh has demanded an FIR and arrest in connection with the matter. Meanwhile, CM Yogi Adityanath has taken a tough stance on the issue, which has sparked unease among some Sangh leaders.
